text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is surrounded by circles of various friends.
Yes, circles beyond just the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: The Six
text_block_list.text: Yay, Happy Holidays☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants juice!
The fizzy, bubbly, carbonated kind!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Well, of course. All carbonated drinks are fizzy, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sing! Diggity~ dig~♪
Woohoo, yeehaw~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The beginning was... definitely Christmas, yes.
Though it instantly turned into something else entirely."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's gotta be this crew♪
That totally bizarre, feel-at-home vibe☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I guess families can be pretty baffling.
Though the Mejiros aren't really like that.
A close group of Umamusume gathered for a Christmas party. Twin Turbo was an outrageous, runaway front-runner—

Matikanetannhauser is an earnest yet soothing,
heartwarming Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, quite a few of the girls here
are running in this year's Arima Kinen, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Turbo's running!
The time has finally come for me to beat Teio.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I will be racing as well. McQueen-san requested a match with me, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, after a fashion. I gotta break out of the
'runner-up Umamusume' rut somehow!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! Palmer-chin and I are joining too☆
Our runaway duo's gonna make some serious noise~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios, too...?
Even though it's 2500m...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, like, not sweatin' the small stuff? 
Like 1 + 1 equals 100, and surprises just kinda happen, y'know? ★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Forget about that! Let's keep this party hyped up♪ And so—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yay, one-hit gag festival☆
Bzz-bzz-bzz-vroom!

"As if to cut the conversation short,
a sudden gag contest broke out."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyyy, Nature's up first☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, me~?
Stop tossing to me like I'm some light appetizer~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm, then I'll do an impression. Teio's face
when she drinks Hachimi Drink and it's super delicious.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooooh, I don't really get it, but watching Nature casually observe like that is so cute~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't judge it based on something
that has nothing to do with the quality!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next up, Iku-no! Iku-no!
Take off the glasses, the glasses☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I hardly believe that sort of thing
qualifies as art, but—
(Click)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Is it like this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Trainy, is this more of a yes than a no?
Or more of a no than a yes?
choice_data_list: I'd say that's definitely a yes.
I'd say that's leaning towards a yes, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy-yay, cleared qualifiers☆ Glasses-less
Ikuno, nope-no way, but so yaaayyyy♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next, Palmer!
Put on a ponytail and play golf!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Po-ny-go♪ Po-ny-go♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There's no sport like that! What's with this vibe!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you keep asking for unreasonable things, Turbo's gonna mess up your hair!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah, as if I'd let you catch me!
You won't get me—wanna race against my runaway lead?!
...The venue was in absolute chaos, like someone had overturned a giant pot of mapo tofu.
And—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hnnng-snooore, honk-shooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Shupi~, fushurururu~~~...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* The room's a total mess again.
Time to clean, clean, clean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
I'll take care of this, so go rest on the sofa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it. It happens all the time,
so I'm used to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "I feel calmer when you're watching over me. So, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*, is it that late already...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Palmer-san.
I'll help to—... huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, is the mood getting a little romantic?
Well, well, well...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Time for this third wheel to scram, scram...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
Also, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um, Merry Christmas♪
Just in case, since I hadn't said it properly yet.

In the dead of night when everyone is sound asleep,
words of celebration are secretly exchanged.

And so, the delightful feast before the decisive battle
quietly drew to a close...

And after the party ended,
I walked through the city together with Mejiro Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Helios said it feels 'just like home,'
but nobody's home is that loud."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you know... To be honest,
I was kind of thinking the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just as much as the time I spend with the Mejiro family back home, I've been spending more and more time having fun with those girls, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It kinda feels natural to me now, in a way.
For someone from a respectable family, I've strayed pretty far off the path, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I guess I just can't bring myself to act like an ojou-sama, after all.
Yet Mejiro Palmer's face didn't look displeased in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, at this rate,
I might not even be able to go back to the Mejiro estate~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What should we do, Trainer? What if I keep
blasting ahead like this and completely derail my life?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If we just leave it to vibes, who knows
what'll happen down the road! What should we do?
I think to myself. If Mejiro Palmer were to stray too far off course, then—
choice_data_list: Shall we go completely off the rails together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All the way...? Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see, I see. You might worry about me,
but you won't stop me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you're right... That's how
you've carved your own path all along.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Reindeer have no need to look back!
We only charge forward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Because I've got Santa right by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, let's kick it into even higher gear from here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Keep a tight grip on the reins, Trainer.
Do that, and no matter how wildly I sprint, we'll be just fine!
